sfw_lora_candidates.name: HuMeow / cat anthropomorph SFW LoRA (Flux route B)
sfw_lora_candidates.note: Search Civitai for HuMeow or equivalent SFW cat-anthro LoRA; confirm license + no NSFW merge before download. Do NOT list undress models.

precision_policy.note: Qwen looklock uses fp8mixed OK. The Wan fp16-only policy is separate and does NOT apply to Qwen.

notes: Qwen looklock default UNET = qwen_image_edit_2511_fp8mixed.safetensors (fp8mixed OK); Wan's 'ban fp8' policy does NOT apply to Qwen.
Do NOT add --force-fp16 for Qwen (black-image risk). Never launch with --use-sage-attention.

Lightning LoRA (qwen_edit_2511_lightning_4steps) is optional speed only: use only with the fp8mixed base and never stack it on a fused lightning checkpoint. The quality gate keeps Lightning OFF (Enable 4steps LoRA? = false).
Wan2.1 I2V / FLF2V remain fp16; that is a separate precision policy and must not be reverted by looklock changes.
Optional costume_ref path: $INPUT_ROOT/looklock/costume_ref_PLACEHOLDER.png (or a refs/ costume placeholder) feeds image2/image3 as a clothing reference; it is an input image, not a weight.

optional_inputs.note: Optional clothing/pose reference for image2/image3; workflow/01 uses looklock/costume_ref_PLACEHOLDER.png (ComfyUI input-relative).
